sections_reviewed: Section IV-A/B (PDF pp. 11–15): object detection, beam embedding and GRU prediction
Section V-A (pp. 16–18): ViWi scenario, sequence construction and split
title: Vision-Aided 6G Wireless Communications: Blockage Prediction and Proactive Handoff
summary: Pretrained and environment-finetuned YOLOv3 detects objects; bounding boxes and observed beam indices are embedded into a GRU for future blockage and proactive handoff. The synthetic 28-GHz ViWi street scenario synchronizes cameras and radio ray tracing.
limits: Published prior art for visual object structure plus RF history and proactive communication decisions. The reviewed scenario is one synthetic downtown setting with camera-specific sequence samples; it does not establish cross-warehouse or lower-band Wi-Fi transfer.
